ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (white) pixels; the right lobe exhibits significantly higher white pixel density than the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: dense white micro-mottling on a dark background concentrated at the base and outer edge. Right lobe: large contiguous white geometric region on the distal half containing dark concentric ring patterns; the proximal region remains primarily low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 52 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; trailing edges are characterized by jagged peaks and narrow valleys, with prominent irregular protrusions on the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep on the trailing edge, with the outer margins displaying a tapered concavity towards the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-contrast circular clusters along the distal margins (consistent with barnacle attachment points) and dark ring-shaped pigmentation clusters on the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral protrusions and textured calcification clusters along the trailing edge and outer margins indicative of sessile barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique ocellus-like (ring-shaped) pigmentation patterns located on the mid-distal white region of the right fluke lobe.
